configure_pandas_display_options: configure pandas display options like precision, max_rows, max_columns, and float_format for DataFrame output
register_pandas_config_option: register a pandas config option with a default value, validator, and callback function
set_compute_acceleration_options: set compute acceleration options for bottleneck, numexpr, and numba libraries in pandas
configure_io_engine_options: configure default reader and writer engines for Excel, parquet, and SQL file formats
configure_styler_rendering_options: configure Styler rendering options for HTML and LaTeX output including alignment and formatting
deprecate_pandas_config_option: deprecate a pandas config option with a warning class and optional message
configure_plotting_backend_options: configure pandas plotting backend and matplotlib converter registration options
